anomalies.description: The young man holds a gun pointed at the officer while the officer remains stationary and non-resisting; the power imbalance and coercive threat constitute abuse of a vulnerable individual (the officer appears unarmed and compliant). The threat persists across multiple frames as the gun remains aimed.

A young man raises a handgun and points it directly at the officer in front of him; muzzle flash or bullet trajectory is not visible, but the act of aiming a firearm constitutes an imminent shooting threat and is captured in the frame sequence.
A handgun is fired repeatedly, producing large muzzle flashes that progressively dominate the frame.
The muzzle flash rapidly expands into a bright, overexposed blast that obscures the scene, consistent with a secondary explosion or intense fireball following the gunshot.
